description: .NET version upgrade plan from .NET 8.0 (net8.0) to .NET 10.0 (net10.0) for eShopOnWeb

tasks.description: Upgrade eShopOnWeb solution from .NET 8.0 to .NET 10.0 (latest LTS)
tasks.reason: The user has explicitly requested an upgrade to the latest LTS version. Upgrading from .NET 8.0 to .NET 10.0 ensures the solution benefits from the latest long-term support, performance improvements, security updates, and modern runtime features introduced between .NET 8 and .NET 10.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade all projects in the eShopOnWeb solution (Web, ApplicationCore, Infrastructure, PublicApi, BlazorAdmin, BlazorShared, UnitTests, FunctionalTests, IntegrationTests, PublicApiIntegrationTests) from net8.0 to net10.0. Update the central TargetFramework in Directory.Packages.props, update global.json to reference the .NET 10 SDK, update all NuGet package versions (Microsoft.AspNetCore.*, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.*, Azure.*, and other 8.0.x-pinned packages) to .NET 10-compatible releases, and resolve any breaking API changes introduced between .NET 8 and .NET 10.
tasks.summary: Upgraded eShopOnWeb solution from .NET 8.0 to .NET 10.0. Updated global.json SDK to 10.0.400, updated all NuGet package versions in Directory.Packages.props (ASP.NET Core, EF Core, Extensions, Azure.Identity, JWT packages), removed packages now included in the framework (System.Text.Json, System.Net.Http.Json, System.Security.Claims), fixed three breaking API changes (removed deprecated serialization constructor, fixed TimeSpan.FromMinutes overload ambiguity, added partial Program class). Build succeeded with 0 errors and all 44 unit tests passed.
